pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Have you ever noticed a pattern? Have you ever seen something repeat? Have you ever looked at two things and said, "Wow, those are so similar"? We see patterns all the time. We see them in nature. We see them in music. We see them in history. The Bible is full of patterns. It is full of parallels. It is full of types. And every parallel points to one person. Every type points to Jesus.


The Old Testament tells stories about people. It tells stories about Abraham. It tells stories about Joseph. It tells stories about Moses. It tells stories about David. It tells stories about Jonah. These are not random stories. They are not just history lessons. They are parallel lives. They are patterns. They are types. And every single one of them runs parallel to Jesus.


This book is for the curious. It is for the spiritual seeker who wants to see the pattern. It is for the person who wants to understand the parallel. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 parallel lives. We are going to see the patterns. We are going to see the parallels. And we are going to see how they all point to Jesus. They are the types. Jesus is the antitype.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not see the Old Testament as just a collection of old stories. You will see it as a gallery of parallels. You will see it as a pattern. You will see it as a blueprint. You will understand the ancient types. You will understand the parallel lives. You will understand why they matter today. You will have a new confidence in your faith. You will have a new love for your Bible. And you will have a new appreciation for the one who is the fulfillment of every parallel.

The Hook
Have you ever noticed a pattern? Have you ever seen something repeat? Have you ever looked at two things and said, "Wow, those are so similar"? The Bible is full of patterns. It is full of parallels. And the first parallel is the firstborn. The firstborn was special. The firstborn was set apart. The firstborn was a type. And the firstborn points to Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Consecrate to me every firstborn male. The first offspring of every womb among the Israelites belongs to me, whether human or animal." - Exodus 13:2 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The firstborn was consecrated. The firstborn was set apart. The firstborn belonged to God. The firstborn was a type. The firstborn was a shadow. The firstborn was a parallel.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters." - Romans 8:29


Jesus is the firstborn. He is the firstborn of all creation. He is the firstborn from the dead. He is the firstborn among many brothers and sisters. The firstborn in the Old Testament is a type. It is a shadow. It is a parallel. The reality is Jesus.


The Verdict
The firstborn is a parallel. It points to Jesus. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The antitype is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel special? Do you feel set apart? Do you feel like you belong? Remember the firstborn. Remember Jesus. You are part of the family. You are a brother. You are a sister. You are included.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the firstborn. Thank you for making me part of the family. Thank you for including me. Help me to see the pattern. Help me to see the parallel. Help me to follow the antitype. Amen.

END MATTER


The 30-Day Parallel Challenge
You have journeyed through 30 parallel lives. You have seen the patterns. You have seen the parallels. Now what? I challenge you to read the Gospel of John. It is 21 chapters. It will show you how Jesus is the fulfillment of every parallel. As you read, look for the pattern. Look for the parallel. Look for Jesus.


A Note on Faith
The parallels are evidence. They are evidence of a divine plan. But evidence does not save you. The parallels point to a person. The parallels point to Jesus. You can understand the parallels and still miss the ultimate parallel. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The parallels are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.
